hero.h1: 12 Best Craft Cocktail Bars in Seoul 2026 — Reddit-Backed Guide
hero.subtitle: Seoul has quietly become one of Asia's most exciting cocktail cities — with 6 bars in Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025. We combed Reddit threads, bar industry rankings, and local recommendations to find where Seoul actually drinks.

methodology: We analyzed 80+ Reddit posts and 300+ comments across r/seoul, r/koreatravel, r/cocktails, and r/korea — spanning 2022 to 2025. Bars were cross-referenced with Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025 and World's 50 Best Bars 2024 rankings. We weighted Reddit responses from Seoul residents and serious cocktail travelers more heavily than casual tourist recommendations.
